title: Error-weighted latency compass by route & model (stream vs non-stream breakdown)
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a dashboard and associated pipelines that surfaces latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) for each model+route combination with explicit streaming vs non-streaming decomposition and an error-weighted overlay. The goal is to help SREs and model owners quickly identify cases where increased error rates are amplifying tail latency or where streaming paths diverge from batch behavior. This ticket covers: 1) metric and log pipeline changes to emit an 'io_mode' tag (streaming|sync), 'model_route' tag, and an 'error_flag' per request; 2) tracing hook updates to include sampling hints for representative slow+error traces; 3) dashboard panels with rankable model/route rows, sparklines for percentiles, stacked bars for stream vs non-stream composition, and a right-hand column showing error-weighted latency (p95 multiplied by error-rate factor) to prioritize investigation.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics pipeline emits model_route and io_mode labels for >99% of production requests within the retention window
Tracing hooks annotate 1 in 500 slow/error requests with full trace export and sampling hint
Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 per model_route and splits streaming vs non-streaming via stacked area or bars
Error-weighted latency column is computed and sorted; top 10 offenders identified in the dashboard
Queries and panels have runbook links and drilldowns to sample traces and related logs
Alert rule proposal for >20% increase in error-weighted p95 for any model_route over 1h window
implementation_notes: Metrics: add io_mode and model_route labels in the request router telemetry (runtime agent) and ensure they are preserved through the aggregation pipeline (Prometheus -> remote write -> Cortex / Bigtable).
Logs: add request_status and error_flag fields to structured logs; update Fluentbit config to route these to the observability cluster with 7d retention for trace correlation work.

Tracing: add a lightweight sampling hint header on responses when a request is both slow (p95 threshold) and has error_flag; configure collector to sample at 0.2% baseline + upsample of hinted traces to 10% for a 24h window after anomalies.

Dashboard: implement in Grafana using LOKI/PromQL or BigQuery depending on panel; prefer PromQL for near-real-time panels and BigQuery for historical large-cohort analysis. Use template variables for model_family, region, and route.
Query examples: PromQL percentiles aggregated by model_route and io_mode, and an expression for error-weighted p95 = p95 * (1 + error_rate).
Rollout plan: feature flag the metric additions, deploy tracing hook in canary region, validate with synthetic requests before enabling globally.

Telemetry cost consideration: tag cardinality must be controlled; only include model_family + route slug, avoid raw model hash to keep series manageable. Consider pre-aggregation for low-cardinality dashboards.
